Name: Mine Tryphophobia Fix
Author: ashervy02
Description:
There's a wall area in the slime levels of the mine that is potentially triggering to trypophobia. Image under a spoiler tag if you're not familiar.
[spoiler][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/b122dbf1e206711d8c8f7dcad9b92a61/69ad3426214633cf-de/s400x600/c294250748f64c37343701364e09032497126448.jpg[/img][/spoiler]
This replaces that wall texture with a blank one instead. I'm not experienced with mod creation, so these are xnb files that you drag and drop to replace in content. This is not a content patcher mod, and it does not go in your mods folder.

If anyone wants to create a CP version you're more than welcome to.
